sentences.text:
Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.5019 Of 2019
Order:

1. The petitioner/accused No.2 seeks to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.83 of 2019 of Guntakal I Town Police Station, Anantapur District, which was registered against him and another accused for the offences under Sections 328, 270, 272 and 273 R/w 34 of IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, 'the FSS Act').
2.

entities.text: Guntakal I Town Police Station, Anantapur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The allegations against the petitioner briefly are that on 02.07.2019 at 05.00 p.m., the complainant suo motu registered the case against A-1 and the petitioner/A-2 on the ground that A-1 is in possession of the banned tobacco products and on interrogation A-1 confessed to have purchased the banned tobacco products from the petitioner/A-2 for sale at higher price and as the accused voluntarily confessed to have been engaged in the business of prohibited tobacco products,
seized the same and registered F.I.R. for the offences stated supra.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore the police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.

He relied upon the order of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of UDPR,J 2018 and batch,
dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the Criminal Petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioner/accused No.2 for the offences under Sections 328, 270, 272 and 273 R/w 34 of IPC and Section 59(i)of FSS Act are hereby quashed.

5. As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.
________________________________ U. DURGA PRASAD RAO, J Date:28.08.2019 Dsh T.N.Hari Krishna vs State Of Ap on 28 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81402024/
